posts.author: ezioking86
posts.body: Hello community. I'm looking to make a vending machine that changes its stock every 20 real time minutes. I would like to do this without a plug-in. I'm thinking the vending machines from "Borderlands" as an example. Can anyone provide me help in doing so. I'm new to RPG Maker MZ and don't understand the basic variable usage and script commands. Thank you in advance to anyone who can help.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
ezioking86 said:
and don't understand the basic variable usage
Click to expand...
Then that is where you have to start.
Sorry, but variables are the basic command necessary for anything that is more complex than a "go there" quest, and you need variables especially to remember the items in the machine during those 20 minutes.
There is an old tutorial game "Variables Guide" for VXA, and its command and use of variables is identical between VXA, MV and MZ.
If you don't find it by searching the forum, it is linked in my starting point tutorial (see signature)
Please learn how to use variables and then come back here and we'll tell you how to event such a machine.
